scope: Developer-authored export software contracts and an actual two-revision upload/download browser flow; not expert accuracy, identity authentication or model quality

assertions: repeated and overlapping quotes without occurrence offset are ambiguous
explicit second occurrence matches; negative/fraction/string/unsafe integer/null offsets rejected
same current text cannot confirm stale saved version or parse identity
missing legacy identity stays unknown while current text-only check remains explicit
physical page mismatch rejected when both page identities are present
source trailing whitespace preserved; LF not replaced by space
raw anchors, retrieval, source and input version unchanged
Markdown names ambiguous, stale and missing identity separately

controls.kind: Actual empty workspace, two DOCX uploads, local retrieval, browser JSON and Markdown downloads

both saved retrieval identities bind to their own exported version
exact old version download retains first message/source snapshots
entire original version object unchanged after revision and exports
